commit a1be19560b29452fd879f5aaace9acc74af909e9
Author:     Daniel Darnell <daniel@thunderbird.net>
AuthorDate: Thu Oct 3 21:47:07 2024 -0700
Commit:     Daniel Darnell <daniel@thunderbird.net>
CommitDate: Thu Oct 3 21:47:07 2024 -0700

    Bug 1922255 - Port bug 1753621: add upload-symbols-dummy task to Thunderbird CI. r=rjl
    
    Differential Revision: https://phabricator.services.mozilla.com/D224451

diff --git a/taskcluster/docs/kinds.rst b/taskcluster/docs/kinds.rst
index 2d027bece99..213c42b4996 100644
--- a/taskcluster/docs/kinds.rst
+++ b/taskcluster/docs/kinds.rst
@@ -70,3 +70,9 @@ source-docs
 -----------
 
 Build Thunderbird source documentation and upload to RTD.
+
+
+upload-symbols-dummy
+--------------------
+
+Upload-symbols-dummy ensures both x64 and macosx64 tasks run for nightlies and releases.
diff --git a/taskcluster/kinds/upload-symbols-dummy/kind.yml b/taskcluster/kinds/upload-symbols-dummy/kind.yml
new file mode 100644
index 00000000000..28d7d578ca6
--- /dev/null
+++ b/taskcluster/kinds/upload-symbols-dummy/kind.yml
@@ -0,0 +1,26 @@
+# This Source Code Form is subject to the terms of the Mozilla Public
+# License, v. 2.0. If a copy of the MPL was not distributed with this
+# file, You can obtain one at http://mozilla.org/MPL/2.0/.
+---
+loader: taskgraph.loader.transform:loader
+
+transforms:
+    - taskgraph.transforms.from_deps
+    - gecko_taskgraph.transforms.per_platform_dummy
+    - gecko_taskgraph.transforms.mac_dummy
+    - gecko_taskgraph.transforms.task
+
+only-for-build-platforms:
+    macosx64-shippable/opt
+
+kind-dependencies:
+    - build
+    - upload-symbols
+
+tasks:
+    upload-symbols-dummy:
+        description: Dummy task to pull in mac x64 and aarch64 upload-symbols tasks
+        from-deps:
+            group-by: single-with-filters
+            unique-kinds: false
+        worker-type: succeed
